posts.name: Chinmoy Das
posts.cooked: same as the title. i have two laptops. the first one is my personal and second one which i use in office. i was thinking of practicing questions in free time in office, is it possible

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: If you’re referring to the course vm, then you don’t install the vm, you just connect to an existing server using the SSH protocol. If you want to use the course VM with two devices, then make sure to copy over both the public and private key to the other device as well.

posts.name: Chinmoy Das
posts.cooked: Cool, it works that means. Thank you that’s a relief.

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked: Small correction. You need to copy private key too. Identity is verified using private key. Not public key.

posts.name: Chinmoy Das
posts.cooked: copy the keys and store them in a particular path right

posts.name: Ishan Shishodiya
posts.cooked: Yes under your .ssh directory available in your home directory or C:\Users\<username> on Windows.
